column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: They destroyed the entire land, killing everything living.  The Necromancer King was bent on destroying everything.  Our land has been defiled, now nothing grows where fertile farmland once was.  There was never any fight.  Our Warlock-Sorceress alliance was too young to form an army.  Now, the remainder of us are forced to flee, maybe someday to return in search of vengeance!!!
column5: 奴らは大地をことごとく破壊し、すべての命を奪った。ネクロマンサー王は、何もかも滅ぼすつもりだったのだ。国土は穢され、かつて肥沃な農地だった場所には、もう何も育たない。戦いにすらならなかった。ウォーロックとソーサレスの同盟はまだ若く、軍を整える暇さえなかった。生き残った者たちは逃げるほかない。いつの日かこの地に戻り、復讐を果たすために……！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: A Barbarian ship appears as the sun rises. When they dock, they say "We do not believe your lies.  You will not deceive us again! The last thing we would do is ally with you!" He then runs back to his ship, and throws a sack containing your diplomats head onto the shore.  Now, it is clear what you must do-destroy the Barbarians at all costs!!!
column5: 夜明けとともに、バーバリアンの船が姿を現した。接岸すると、一人の男が叫ぶ。「お前たちの嘘など信じるものか。二度と我々を欺くことはできん！ お前たちと同盟を結ぶなど、断じてありえない！」男は船へ駆け戻り、あなたの外交官の首が入った袋を岸へ投げ捨てた。やるべきことは、もはや明らかだ。どんな犠牲を払ってでも、バーバリアンを滅ぼせ！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: It seems as if luck has given you hope in defeating the evil hordes that now inhabit your land.  They have no idea there are still armies from Alteris alive.  You now have time to form an invasion to take your homeland back!!
column5: どうやら運が味方したようだ。故郷を占拠する邪悪な大軍を打ち破る望みが見えてきた。敵は、アルテリスの軍勢がまだ生き残っていることを知らない。今なら侵攻軍を整え、故郷を取り戻せる！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: You must take castle Visimir quickly! Your resources are running out, and soon the Necromancers will be exploring the sea!  If you combine Visimir with the castles you already own, there is a chance to avenge your countrymen!!!
column5: 急いでヴィシミール城を奪え！ 資源は尽きかけ、ネクロマンサーもじきに海へ探索の手を伸ばす。ヴィシミールと、すでに所有する城々の力を合わせれば、同胞の仇を討てるかもしれない！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: What are you still doing here??  You are surrounded!!!  You must flee now and set up a new kingdom, because soon the Necromancers will be scouting even the seas!!!
column5: まだここで何をしている？ すでに包囲されているぞ！ 今すぐ脱出し、新たな王国を築くのだ。ネクロマンサーはまもなく、海にまで偵察の手を伸ばしてくる！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: After consulting with your advisors you agree you have about one year at the absolute most before the Necromancers would have complete control.  You will have to be very powerful by then.
column5: 助言者たちと協議を重ねた末、結論が出た。ネクロマンサーが完全な支配を確立するまで、長くてもあと1年。それまでに、強大な力を蓄えなければならない。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: You have no hope against the necromancers without the Barbarians castles and resources-you must attack them and take Visimir.  Then and only then will you have enough power to even think of attacking the undead hordes
column5: バーバリアンの城と資源なくして、ネクロマンサーに勝つ望みはない。彼らを攻め、ヴィシミールを奪え。それだけの力を手にして初めて、アンデッドの大軍との戦いが見えてくる。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: The Necromancers have expanded their reign of tyranny, and now have a working kingdom.  They will soon be pushing out to gain the rest of the land!  Take Visimir!!!
column5: ネクロマンサーは圧政の版図を広げ、今や一つの王国を築き上げた。やがて残る土地を求め、進軍を始めるだろう。ヴィシミールを奪え！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: It is over!!!!!! You woke up in the middle of the night to hear the castle in an uproar.  When you look out your minaret window, you see 1000's of skeletons, zombies, vampires, and even more hideous creatures routing your army.  Soon they have taken the walls, and have you captured.  It is all over... the Necromancers have finally destroyed the last living things in the world, and chaos reigns supreme!!!!
column5: すべて終わりだ！ 真夜中、城内の騒ぎで目を覚ました。塔の窓から外を見ると、何千ものスケルトン、ゾンビ、ヴァンパイア、そして名状しがたい怪物たちが、あなたの軍を蹴散らしている。ほどなく城壁は破られ、あなたも捕らえられた。すべては終わった……ネクロマンサーはついに、この世界に残る最後の命まで滅ぼした。今や混沌がすべてを支配している！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: Just capture castle Visimir to win-worry about the undead later!!!
column5: ヴィシミール城さえ奪えば勝利だ。アンデッドのことは後で考えればいい！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: You must flee immediately if you have any hope of survival.  Your heroes are no match for the powerful Necromancers that now rule Alteris.  There is a resource-rich island to the north that may get you off to a good start, but you will need more resources to build up an army big enough to attack the Death King.
column5: 生き延びたいなら、今すぐ逃げろ。あなたの英雄たちでは、今のアルテリスを支配する強大なネクロマンサーに歯が立たない。北には資源豊かな島がある。再起の足掛かりにはなるだろうが、死の王を攻められるほどの軍を築くには、さらに多くの資源が必要だ。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: Your royal advisors remind you of the vicious Barbarians to the north.  They have been your bitter enemies to this day, but may agree to ally with you against the Necromancer hordes.  Even if they don't ally with you, controlling their resource-rich land is very important.
column5: 王室の助言者たちが、北方の凶暴なバーバリアンについて改めて忠告した。彼らは長年の宿敵だが、ネクロマンサーの大軍に対抗するためなら同盟に応じるかもしれない。たとえ同盟を拒まれても、資源豊かな彼らの領土を支配することは極めて重要だ。
